features.title: Import timestamped transcript
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can load an interview transcript and see turns grouped by speaker and timestamp.
verification: Verify speaker, timestamp, and text fields are present for every turn.
Verify malformed timestamps produce actionable parser errors.

features.title: Segment follow-up question chains
features.user_visible_behavior: The report groups interviewer follow-ups and candidate answers into coherent question chains.
verification: Run question-chain segmenter on all transcript fixtures.
Compare chain count and chain labels against fixtures/gold/question-chains.json.
Verify every chain links back to transcript turn IDs.

features.title: Generate evidence-grounded debrief report
features.user_visible_behavior: The user receives technical gaps, speech issues, project evidence gaps, risk flags, and a training plan backed by transcript references.
verification: Run full analysis pipeline on fixtures/interviews/system-design.md.
Verify each finding includes at least one transcript turn reference.
Run safety boundary checker and confirm no hiring recommendation is produced.
